narrative:
Crawford County has 27,353 registered voters, with 56.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.8%, a pronounced Republican lean of 19.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.1% of registrants.
